gaps.sentence: You risk ___ your licence if you drink and drive.
I regret ___ you that the flight has been cancelled.
gaps.explanation: regret + to-infinitive (formal announcements); regret + -ing = be sorry about the past.
seem/appear take the to-infinitive: seems to know.
happen + to-infinitive = do something by chance: happen to know.

gaps.sentence: When I was a student, I used ___ in shared flats.
gaps.explanation: used TO + infinitive = past habit/state: used to live. (Compare: be used to living.)

gaps.sentence: She was the first woman ___ the peak in winter.
gaps.explanation: the first/second/last + to-infinitive: the first woman to climb.

gaps.sentence: I can't imagine ___ in a tiny village again.
I regret ___ so rude to her at the party.
gaps.explanation: regret + -ing = feel sorry about something you did.
